sources.title: NoobAI XL — Open Anime SDXL Model by Laxhar Lab
sources.snippet: NoobAI XL (NAI-XL) is an open anime SDXL checkpoint from Laxhar Dream Lab. Built on Illustrious with full Danbooru and e621 native tags, it aims for strong character coverage, flexible style control, and a friendlier learning curve for new artists.

sources.title: NoobAI-XL (NAI-XL) - V-Pred-1.0-Version | Tensor.Art
sources.snippet: This image generation model, based on Laxhar/noobai-XL_v1.0, leverages full Danbooru and e621 datasets with native tags and natural language captioning. Implemented as a v-prediction model (distinct from eps-prediction), it requires specific parameter configurations - detailed in following sections.
